accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.introduction: The operator of this service is committed to making its digital services accessible.

complianceStatus.title: Compliance Status
complianceStatus.body: The compliance of the service with accessibility standards has not been assessed yet. The team nevertheless strives to provide a service that is accessible to as many people as possible.

improvement.title: Improvement and Contact
improvement.body: If you cannot access content or a service, contact the service operator to be directed to an accessible alternative or to obtain the content in another form.
